delta_review.only_semantic_change_from_prior_review: liveReservationBytes now validates a minimum fixed reservation and the optional in-progress named input size.
checks: Value must cover two maximum raw slots, native spool, bounded metadata, at least one diagnostic byte and at least one stereo frame; a one-byte forged record cannot admit another job.
When input.f32 exists, nofollow fstat requires a regular, nonnegative file no larger than the hard default256MiB input geometry and value must cover its current size plus the fixed overhead.

Accounting permits a partial non-frame-aligned named copy during concurrent capture; the initial worst-case charge already reserves that phase. Missing input remains permissible during initial/failed setup.
The hard input geometry uses the format default rather than a later caller's tighter prepared limit, avoiding destructive reclassification of an existing valid owner.
The existing tighter maxCacheBytes rejection remains length_error, leaves the job intact and cannot bypass shared root accounting.
All additions are bounded below existing integer ceilings. Capture, factory cancellation, process lifecycle and offline paths are byte-unchanged from the previous clear review.

execution: Text/hash/diff source review only; no patch application, build, tests, Git, native/model execution or host-state/audio queries.
qualification: Prior review limitations remain: actual GREEN and required checks are root-owned; no integrated latency/physical-audio qualification is inferred.
